lessons.title: Course Overview
lessons.overview:
## Course Overview

In this video, we will explore the fundamentals of web development in a simple and clear way.

You will learn:
- What web development really means
- How frontend and backend systems work together
- The role of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in modern applications

### What you’ll gain
By the end of this lesson, you will have a clear mental model of how websites and web applications are designed, built, and delivered to users.

This lesson sets the foundation for everything you will learn in the rest of the course.

lessons.title: Fullstack Architecture Overview
lessons.overview:
## Development Environment Setup

This lesson walks you through setting up a professional development environment for fullstack web development.

### Topics covered
- Installing Node.js and npm
- Setting up VS Code with essential extensions
- Understanding project folder structure
- Running your first development server

### Why this matters
A correctly configured environment helps you avoid common setup issues, improve productivity, and follow industry best practices from day one.

Make sure you complete this step before moving on to advanced topics.

lessons.title: Client-Server Communication
lessons.overview:
## Lesson Overview

Client–server communication is the backbone of every web application.

In this lesson, you will learn:
- What happens when a user clicks a button in the browser
- How requests travel from client to server
- How servers process requests and send responses

---

## Key Concepts
- HTTP and HTTPS protocols
- Request methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
- Status codes and their meanings
- JSON as a data exchange format

---

## Why it’s important
Understanding client–server communication will help you debug API issues confidently, build scalable applications, and design clean and maintainable backend services.

assignments.title: React Hook
assignments.description:
## Assignment Overview

In this assignment, you will build a React application that demonstrates effective usage of React Hooks.

### Objectives
- Use `useState` to manage component state
- Use `useEffect` to handle side effects such as API calls
- Create at least one custom hook for reusable logic

### Guidelines
- Follow React Hooks rules
- Write clean and readable code
- Ensure proper component structure

This assignment helps reinforce core React concepts used in modern applications.

assignments.title: Components Life Cycle
assignments.description:
## Assignment Overview

This assignment focuses on understanding the React component lifecycle.

### What you need to do
- Explain lifecycle phases in class components
- Convert lifecycle methods into Hooks
- Demonstrate mounting, updating, and unmounting behavior

### Deliverables
- Source code
- Short explanation document

Completing this assignment will strengthen your understanding of component behavior.

assignments.title: Use State
assignments.description:
## Assignment Overview

This assignment is designed to help you master the `useState` hook.

### Tasks
- Build a form using controlled components
- Manage multiple state values
- Handle user input validation

### Expected Outcome
By completing this assignment, you will be confident in managing state in functional components.

assignments.title: Build a React CRUD Application
assignments.description:
## Assignment Overview

In this assignment, you will build a complete CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) application using React.

### Objectives

- Manage state using `useState` 
-  Fetch data using `useEffect`
- Implement form handling
- Handle list rendering with unique keys
- Use controlled components

### Requirements

1. Create a form to add new items
2. Display items in a list
3. Allow editing existing items
4. Allow deleting items
5.  Maintain clean component structure

### Submission Guidelines

- Submit working source code
- Follow clean coding practices
- Use meaningful variable names
- Handle edge cases properly

This assignment will help you understand real-world React application structure.
